name: Zion Canyon
agency: NPS Zion GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
summary: Soaring Navajo sandstone cliffs, Virgin River narrows, and carved canyon switchbacks.

trails.name: West Rim Trail via Walter's Wiggles to Scout Lookout
trails.condition_note: 21 tight switchbacks of Walter's Wiggles; Angels Landing chain section requires permit.
trails.description: Climbs Refrigerated Canyon and the historic 21 switchbacks of Walter's Wiggles to Scout Lookout (5,790 ft) overlooking Zion Canyon.

trails.name: The Watchman & Pa'rus Trail Loop
trails.condition_note: Great sunset hike from Zion Canyon Visitor Center; Pa'rus segment is dog-friendly.
trails.description: Ascends sandstone benches above the Virgin River to a mesa viewpoint facing the Towers of the Virgin and the Watchman spire.

pois.name: Scout Lookout (5,790 ft)
pois.note: Saddle overlook at base of Angels Landing spine
